dog.description_text:
Meet Mopsy, the sweetest pup you'll ever meet!

Mopsy is a gentle, well-mannered girl who's already mastered the basics. She's potty trained, sleeps soundly through the night, and absolutely loves her crate. It's her cozy safe space, and she'll happily trot into it on her own after walks. She can stay home alone in her crate without a peep. In fact, I haven't heard her cry once.

Like any young pup, she's going through a bit of teething and loves to chew on her toys. She's shown curiosity about the occasional sock, but she lets it go right away when redirected. A quick learner!

Her favorite thing in the world? Affection. Call her name and she'll come running, tail wagging, and roll right over for belly rubs. Neck scratches are a close second. Mopsy is a true sweetheart who's ready to bring calm, cuddly joy to her forever home.

﻿Mopsy is approximately 0y 4m 6d old and may be 50 to 60 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
